title: OpenField Studio: a real render, recorded live
_comment: The demo's time-lapse beat, recorded against a live GPU backend (never the FAKE stack): python scripts/record_demo.py --url http://127.0.0.1:8890/ --scenario scripts/ui/live.scenario.json --out out/live-timelapse. The waits run at 8x with the recorder's time-lapse badge on screen, so the cut is honest about the minutes it skips. Spliced into the main cut after the Moves beat.

steps.text: This part is live: a rented GPU, a real render, cut at eight times speed.
steps.caption: Recorded live on a rented RTX 5090.

steps.text: Ines waits on a harbour pier at golden hour, wind in her hair, gulls over the water
